test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six people, S, T, V, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing North (but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit to the right of S. Only two people sit between W and S. V sits at one of the extreme ends. Y sits to the immediate left of V. T is not an immediate neighbour of S. Who is sitting at the extreme left end?
solution:
Given: Six people, S, T, V, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing North.

1) Only two people sit to the right of S. 

2) Only two people sit between W and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4263e44d35d1308fc67393751f1d53e003abadfc4303a5bf7a19be23b0d5fc56.png] 

3) V sits at one of the extreme ends.

4) Y sits to the immediate left of V. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53618df02089c2c45f43023409c486aec55840e50701c31d79e30df11bb75af5.png] 

5) T is not an immediate neighbour of S. 

After positioning T only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/652ef555103669efa79b932cdfe661be37dded02f31a9e6bc9e632ddb05599f3.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, W is sitting at the extreme left end.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
